Problem Statement: Building a Cost-Efficient AI-Powered HR Assistant

Organisations are increasingly adopting AI-powered chatbots to help employees access HR information relating to leave policies, payroll, employee benefits, insurance, reimbursements, onboarding and other HR processes. While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables intelligent, context-aware responses, the overall cost of operating these solutions can become significant with increasing employee adoption and query volumes.

The challenge is to design and develop a cost-efficient, scalable AI-powered HR Assistant that can handle an multi-step employee conversation at a very minimal targeted cost, including all associated costs such as LLM inference, embedding generation, vector database operations, document retrieval, reranking, context processing and an appropriate allocation of knowledge-base ingestion and infrastructure costs.

Students are expected to explore innovative approaches such as intelligent model selection, semantic caching, optimised retrieval, token consumption reduction and efficient infrastructure utilisation, while maintaining high response accuracy, reliability, data security and employee experience.

The solution must be demonstrated through a working prototype with measurable cost savings and a transparent, end-to-end cost breakdown.

For college level project purpose, first develop reimbursement system with assumed policies. But multi turn conversation, context storing, RAG are must. cost optimization with accuracy is the KPI.
